# Third-party files of the launcher's page

Copied unchanged from their packages; nothing is fetched at run time.

| File | Package | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `preact-htm.js` | `htm@3.1.1` (`preact/standalone.module.js`: Preact 10 with its hooks and htm) | Apache-2.0 (htm, `htm-LICENSE.txt`), MIT (Preact) |
| `../fonts/InterVariable.woff2` | Inter 4.1 (rsms/inter) | SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 (`../fonts/Inter-LICENSE.txt`) |

The icons (`../js/symbols.js`) are Google's Material Symbols Rounded (Apache-2.0), the same
files the game's own interface draws (`assets/icons/material`).
